Patna sahib ke didarganj thana kshetr antargat hiranandpur ganv men jamin ke vivad ko lekar do pakshon ke bich hinsak jharap aur tabartor phayring ki sanasnikhej vardat samne aaee hai.
Is khuni sangharsh men ek hi parivar ke 3 sadasyon samet kul 4 log goli lagne aur marpit men ganbhir rup se ghayal ho gae hain. ghatna ke bad ilake men aphra-taphri ka mahaul kayam ho gaya. sthaniy logon ki madad se sabhi ghaylon ko turant pas ke aspatal men ilaj ke lie bharti karaya gaya hai.
